name: hover-card
description: A preview card shown when hovering or focusing a link. For supplementary detail only.

properties.value: Hover and keyboard focus of the trigger
No hover on touch — never put essential info only here
Not announced as a dialog; keep it short

constraints: Only for previews of information available elsewhere.
The trigger must be focusable (a link or button).
Keep content short — no forms or actions.

notes: Installed 2026-09-22 with AI Elements for the chat panel. Stock source adapted to Enpath: Phosphor icons, light-only classes, shadcn colour names rewritten to Enpath tokens.

docs.intro:
# HoverCard

A preview card shown when hovering or focusing a link. For supplementary detail only.

---

sections.title: What it is
sections.body:
Radix HoverCard. Opens on hover or keyboard focus of its trigger; the content must also be reachable another way.

**Exports:** `HoverCard` · `HoverCardTrigger` · `HoverCardContent`

---

|---|---|

| Text | `color/surface/overlay/foreground` |

| Shadow | `shadow/overlay` |
